name: exp027_paired_padded
notes: EXP-027 paired decision-stability test on a COMMON PADDED domain (configs/belauri_padded_geography, grid.pad_to_m 2000) so that 500 m, 250 m and a true 2 km control share one domain and the original spatial question is kept. dt = res/5 (as 500/100, 250/50), so Courant u*dt/dx = 2.5*400/2000 = 0.5 = the 500 m maximum. alpha_file and noise_scale_file are FROZEN values taken from the UNPADDED domain (results/geodesign); they are reused unchanged, not re-derived on the padded grid. candidate_manifest: the 142 candidate sites are the UNPADDED ones (the interior lattice is anchored to the manifest origin, which padding shifts by 500 m); their UTM positions are kept and local coordinates are recomputed on the padded georef.
